ACME CORPORATION — MULTI-FACTOR AUTHENTICATION POLICY
Document ID: SEC-MFA-2025-001 | Effective: January 1, 2025

REQUIREMENTS
MFA is mandatory for all remote access and admin accounts.
Finance, HR, and Engineering departments must enroll by June 30, 2025.
Hardware security keys are recommended for privileged accounts.

ENROLLMENT
Employees enroll via sso.acme-corp.com using the corporate identity portal.
New hires must enable MFA within 5 business days of account creation.

COMPLIANCE
Non-compliant accounts are flagged weekly and escalated to department managers.
Remote workers without MFA will have VPN access revoked after the deadline.

CONTACT: security@acme-corp.com
